summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness in the broad market, evidenced by massive $6.8B in SPX BuyCalls and an extremely low 0.31 P/C ratio. Significant directional conviction is visible in massive SPX 7000C accumulations (exp 2026/2027) totaling billions, alongside aggressive AMD call buying ($200.3M) and META call dominance ($244.2M). Persistent interest is confirmed by multi-day accumulation in SPX 7000C (exp 2026-12-18) totaling over $4.6B and SPX 200C (exp 2026-10-16) at $4.6B, signaling a long-term structural bullish bias. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in SPX and tech leaders (AMD, META), but monitor the NDX and IWM for signs of rotation, as NDX shows heavy put buying ($104.5M) and IWM shows extreme put dominance (2.52 P/C).
